biggest_catch: Superprof lets tutors set their own rates, so it publishes no concrete worker pay figure and no payout schedule.
catches: No official concrete worker pay figure: every tutor sets their own rates.
New tutors must offer their first lesson free to each new student (unless Premium or Super Tutor).
Superprof's secure payment option carries a 10% commission; direct outside-platform payments are commission-free.
Payment is arranged between student and tutor - Superprof does not process lesson payments.

c4.evidence: Fails both the official-pay and official-timing requirements.

eligibility: Create a free tutor profile; set your subjects, rates, and availability.

notes: Superprof is a real tutoring marketplace with zero commission on direct payments, but since tutors set their own rates there is no platform-wide concrete pay figure or payout schedule to verify.
